items.a: Nexus is solely developed by fish98547, I do not plan on adding any other developers to this project.

items.q: Do I need to pay to use Nexus?
items.a: No! Nexus will always stay free. While a premium plan is in development that is for a expansion on features and not a lock for features, all features will remain free though limits will soon be put in place.
The Nexus account was made June 17 2026, though the code was first started to be worked on in April 18 2026.

items.q: How long did it take to make Nexus?
items.a: The base 1.0 version took around 5 months, starting April 18 2026 and releasing September 8 2026
No, Nexus is not discontinued and is still being worked on till this day. There is no plan to shutdown/discontinue Nexus for the far future.
No, none of Nexus`s code will be open to the public. Though the website is open source on GitHub..

items.q: Can I join the Nexus team?
items.a: Of course, join out support server where we have links to the applications area. You may apply to join the team and support Nexus.

items.q: Can Nexus replace my other bots?
items.a: Absolutely, Nexus was meant to clean up the clutter in your server with the 10 random bots conflicting with each other. Nexus is one central hub that serves your entire class.
